titleText: What I can do for you

servicesData.title: Static Site Generation Service
servicesData.shortDescription: Bring speed and efficiency to your website with Static Site Generation (SSG) using Astro, Jekyll, and Next.js. This service focuses on building ultra-fast, SEO-friendly, and scalable websites, ensuring a seamless user experience with pre-rendered content and optimized performance. Whether you need a personal portfolio, blog, or business landing page, static sites provide the ideal solution with minimal server dependencies.
servicesPoints: "Blazing-Fast Performance – Pre-rendered pages load instantly, reducing latency."
"SEO Optimization – Improved indexing and search rankings with static HTML."
"Reduced Server Load – No complex backend, ensuring lightweight operations."
"Secure & Reliable – No dynamic vulnerabilities, enhancing security."
"Cross-Platform Deployment – Easily deploy across Vercel, Netlify, and other hosting services."
"Optimized for Mobile & Accessibility – Fully responsive designs for enhanced user experience."
"Scalability & Cost-Efficiency – Ideal for projects that require low maintenance and high performance."

servicesData.title: Full Stack Web Development
servicesData.shortDescription: Transform your vision into a fully functional and scalable website with expert frontend and backend support. I provide a seamless development experience with technologies tailored to your needs.
servicesPoints: "Customizable Frontend – Choose between Astro, React, or Angular to create a stunning and responsive UI."
"Robust Backend Solutions – Select from .Net Web API, MongoDB, Xata, or Supabase for a secure and efficient backend."
"End-to-End Development – From database setup to API integrations, ensuring smooth performance and scalability."
"Optimized & Secure – Implementing SEO, authentication, and deployment best practices for a reliable web presence."
